Real project · Legal & non-profit

EqualFaith Europe

A serious, editorial website for a civil-society initiative working on the enforcement of EU anti-discrimination law — built so that legal work is easy to find, read and cite.

Discuss a similar website
Type
Real project
Industry
Legal & non-profit
Services
Web design, Content structure, Responsive build
Language
English

Overview

EqualFaith Europe researches, drafts and files legal submissions on EU anti-discrimination law, digital rights and AI. The website had to carry long, formal content without feeling heavy — and to read as credible to regulators, journalists and supporters alike.

Business goals

  • Look credible to institutions and the press at first glance
  • Make complaints, submissions and briefings easy to find and download
  • Explain a complex mission in plain language
  • Be open about funding, status and governance

Design approach

A paper-white background, deep navy and a muted gold accent give the site the calm of a legal publication. Headings are set in a classic serif, body text in a clean sans-serif, and references in a monospace face, like citations.

Publications, priorities, transparency, articles and a book page share one strict grid. Each filing is shown with its legal basis and status, so the work speaks for itself.
